text:
Type: tall bookcase with crown molding
Use: storing and displaying books and decor; living room, home office, library, dining room
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: painted wood board, beadboard back panel, molded trim
Colors: light grey, soft cool grey
Shape: tall rectangular open case with a stepped cornice on top, tongue-and-groove back, small curved brackets under each shelf, plinth base with a shaped cutout, substantial visual weight
Feel: elegant, stately, calm, homely
Goes with: white or cream walls, dark wood floors, linen sofas, brass details; classic, traditional or farmhouse living rooms

product.name: LIATORP
product.description: Cornice and plinth rail help create a uniform expression when two or more units are connected together.
